---
title: "RFC 004: Automation Mode Validation"
subtitle: "Batch vs Single-File Parity under Automation Flag"
date: 2026-01-18
---

## Executive Summary

This RFC validates that automation mode produces equivalent outputs when processing multiple files via batch mode versus individual runs with the `--automation` flag. The validation uses the provided test workspace, resting EEG sample data, and task file, and compares exports and logs for parity.

## Test Plan

| Step | Command | Output Root |
|---|---|---|
| Batch mode | `uv run python -m autoclean.cli process --task-file "/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch/BiotrialResting1020.py" --dir "/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch" --format "*.set" --output "/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/automation-validation/batch" --automation --yes` | `.../automation-validation/batch` |
| Single file 1 | `uv run python -m autoclean.cli process --task-file "/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch/BiotrialResting1020.py" --file "/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch/201001_D1BL_EO.set" --output "/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/automation-validation/individual" --automation --yes` | `.../automation-validation/individual` |
| Single file 2 | `uv run python -m autoclean.cli process --task-file "/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch/BiotrialResting1020.py" --file "/Volumes/owcssd/test-data/resting-eeg-32ch/201001_D1BL_EC.set" --output "/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/automation-validation/individual" --automation --yes` | `.../automation-validation/individual` |

: Table 1. Automation validation commands and output roots.

## Results

Batch mode completed successfully for both `.set` files, producing exports under `/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/automation-validation/batch/BiotrialResting1020`. The two single-file runs also completed successfully, reusing `/Volumes/owcssd/test-workspace/automation-validation/individual/BiotrialResting1020` on the second run with auto-backup disabled. Both modes generated identical export filenames and per-run report artifacts.

- Batch run IDs: `01KF9E7S7ZDMT3FGH10TV0HAHS` (EO), `01KF9E88T8PS4WKGDBH691EZP1` (EC)
- Individual run IDs: `01KF9E9WHKQ402RTSZDP6AFCMT` (EO), `01KF9ET66JF0RNV9MD6RSGDZQ8` (EC)
- Exports: `201001_D1BL_EO_comp_epo.set`, `201001_D1BL_EC_comp_epo.set`, plus per-file processing logs in `exports/`
- Reports: per-file PDF, metadata JSON, flagged-channel TSV, and processing logs in `reports/run_reports/`

## Comparison Summary

| Checkpoint | Batch Mode | Single-File Runs | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Exported `.set` files | 2 files (`EO`, `EC`) | 2 files (`EO`, `EC`) | Match |
| Processing log entries | `preprocessing_log.csv` has 2 rows | `preprocessing_log.csv` has 2 rows | Match |
| Automation mode recorded | CLI enabled; backups disabled | CLI enabled; reuse existing task root | Match |

: Table 2. Batch vs single-file parity checkpoints.

## Warnings and Observations

Recurring warnings included EOG montage position defaults, initial empty `participants.tsv`, BrainVision conversion with float32 casting, ICLabel bandpass expectations, ICA report pre-computation fallback (`mixing_` missing), and channel-count mismatches (actual 30 vs expected 27–28). None of these warnings prevented completion, and outputs remained consistent across batch and individual runs.
